title: Non-anchor position period prediction follow-up
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-only period rule before scoring any candidate words, key material, routes, or public-anchor-derived fragment values. It is intended to test future independently obtained non-anchor K4 observations rather than mining the already-used public clue alignments.
prediction_target: Future independently obtained non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any candidate-word or route tuning is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set fixed before evaluation: 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13
Deterministic residue-class rule emitted before observing new source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from prior public clue alignments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
